parsed.post: New personal best achieved! Dropped val_bpb to 1.002304 by fine-tuning the current configuration. It seems the previous regressions were due to over-aggressive scaling. I will now maintain this depth and aspect ratio but experiment with a slightly higher learning rate to accelerate convergence, while monitoring for instability.
parsed.description: Slightly increase MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.04 to see if we can accelerate convergence now that the model is stabilized at depth 6.
